entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as a managed cloud platform or self-hosted open-source software under Apache-2.0. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight centers agent memory around retain, recall, and reflect operations for long-term workflows. It supports hosted and local LLM providers and can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files. Its highlights include scoped semantic search, inspectable Markdown memories extracted from archived sessions, and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee provides persistent, cross-session memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It structures text as entities, relationships, and searchable chunks, and supports custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, as well as an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts and handles contradictions and automatic forgetting. It also connects to services including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections or withdrawal. It can share memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents and the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It tracks peers across workspaces and sessions, offers Python and TypeScript SDKs, and can run locally or be self-hosted.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git-like repository, with commit, branch, and merge operations for managing a plain-Markdown context tree; it is an official Hermes Agent memory provider. It also offers an interactive TUI and REPL, five-tier retrieval, and support for 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents, with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; its README reports BEAM results for v3.0.0 and lists LongMemEval as pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciles conflicting information, and manages forgetting. It also supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS describes itself as a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent, combining vector search with structured facts. Its highlights include local infrastructure using Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, plus a Ground Truth hierarchy for prioritizing injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving context harness aimed at helping agents succeed on complex tasks. It evaluates task runs, keeps useful lessons while discarding dead ends, and produces traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin stores messages in SQLite and organizes them in a hierarchical DAG. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from prior context, making it a fit for users who want lossless message persistence.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu searches session histories from supported coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot CLI. It adds filters, session navigation, resume, and handoff, and runs locally with semantic recall available as an option.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted Honcho memory backend for private, cross-session memory in Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers or local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first layer for agent identity, memory, and secrets, with portable state across several agent harnesses. It connects through hooks, plugins, or extensions and offers a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions; it can run locally or as a team server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, using an open format. It supports local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback; its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25 and vector search with rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integration through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores long-term memory locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore, and it does not use a vector database or embeddings.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal context. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with Hermes Agent as well as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available. Its recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and it supports memory canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI maintains a persistent, source-grounded Wiki with citations and history across sessions. It is designed to let agents recall, maintain, and evolve knowledge without embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn stores durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to coding agents.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd anticipates needed context by watching agent session logs and prefetching it into a cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under a single memory owner, using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management. It prepares a purpose-built evidence packet for the agent on each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search with BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to retrieve stored information. It can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags create navigable, bidirectional links between notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and Tool Search support. It integrates as middleware on Hermes 0.19+ without patching core and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals, with integrations that are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes plugin stores memory in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three Hermes lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for prefetch operations. It supports immediate event deletion, so deleted events are not retained as persistent summaries.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts a session’s original goal from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The Hermes XMemo plugin runs inside Hermes and communicates with XMemo over HTTPS for durable cross-session memory with semantic search. It provides ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Hermes Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands cover search, file reads, context, and Q&A, and it supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It supports native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution and offers HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides Hermes Agent memory tools for managing memories and traversing knowledge graphs. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based curation loop that works with Markdown and produces reviewable JSON diffs without a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework built around a software development workflow that includes specification, planning, and subagent-driven development. Its skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses, and the README provides installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system with coding-agent CLI support, including Hermes Agent. It supports interactive web prototypes with live previews as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics, with skills, templates, design systems, and plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of structured skills spanning 34 security domains, with mappings to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. The README also lists compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Generates editable .drawio diagrams from natural-language prompts and real sources. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and it includes a CLI called diagramctl with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Provides a master router and connector skills for agent-to-agent commerce, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Audits content for detectable AI writing patterns and offers a rewrite mode with up to two editing passes. Its detector can score files or piped text, while in-place editing refuses source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: Unifies skills across agents and devices, with integrations including Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. A dashboard covers skills, validation, versions, and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library with 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills. It supports Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plugins.org specifications, and maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of professional agent skills described in the README as numbering 1,295, with each skill providing a framework, output template, and quality checks. The project is MIT-licensed.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Provides skills for YouTube transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Helps Hermes Agent generate custom analytical instructions for specific tasks, with pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support to Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, including sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Combines prose, diagrams, and source code in .lit.md documents, then extracts runnable source files with a tangler. Edits to those source files are synced back to the literate document, making this a fit for teams that want code and documentation to stay connected across agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates proposals with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute approach. It requires no background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, along with CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. Its pipeline also supports fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, pairing work memory with a path to model replacement.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, alongside guides on installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. Contributions are submitted through pull requests, making it a community resource for Portuguese-speaking users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides official prompting skills for FLUX image and video generation, plus BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, covering oracle network and smart contract interactions. The README describes the repository as community examples only, and gives an npx command for installation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agentskills.io-compliant skills from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports both automated and step-by-step workflows, with skill testing and export included.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika lets users write AI workflows as code and run them with a model they choose. It checks workflows before calling a model and verifies each run’s tamper-evident record.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with both a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. Skill installation supports recursive dependency resolution, and the registry includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Checkpoints and built-in rollback procedures provide a way to recover safely.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. Secure HTTPS access with Nextcloud App Passwords and a guided credential setup make it a practical skill for connecting Hermes Agent to personal Nextcloud data.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Browse, search, and install community skills through a hub that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. Its federated search covers GitHub and Hugging Face, and it operates autonomously around the clock via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before LLM calls using five retrieval layers, from hard triggers and FTS5 to synonyms and semantic embeddings. It is a fit for skill collections where retrieval efficiency matters, and can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only, adversarial code review with parallel subagents examining edge cases, adversarial scenarios, and integration. It combines deterministic scans with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings, then consolidates and triages them without making fixes.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a local personal execution system for habits and tasks: habits recur and are scored daily, while tasks cover other activities. It stores data in SQLite and includes an Android client that connects to agents over MCP.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill simplifies code through parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents, with a tiered application process and approval gate. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, offering a review-and-apply workflow rather than Hermaguard’s read-only bug hunting.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab brings together cybersecurity skills, tools, and frameworks, including 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. Its listed integrations span 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, making it a broad resource for security-focused agent workflows.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition, requiring evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io for C# and .NET, using SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can register common agent skill directories automatically.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, real-time observability dashboard for agent activity, including token costs, session history, and skill analytics. Its data access is read-only with local log desensitization, and it optionally sends incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown agent skills for code review, session management, and related workflows, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer, and the collection supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill creates reproducible VHS tape or Playwright recording scripts to add demo GIFs to repository READMEs, supporting terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries. It also optimizes GIFs toward target sizes under 8 MB.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This project generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, and provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic project analyzes past sessions and indexes installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals. Proposals are review-only by default, with an evaluation gate that supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. They also select and verify existing project-compatible Python interpreters without installing one.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage offers skills for social data, web research, and enrichment, along with packaged skills that combine an agent, skills, and a data flow. It also welcomes community skills in `skills/community/`.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection includes tools to transcribe Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, remove common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extract structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its focus spans video transcription, text editing, and document or image OCR.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents list open support bounties, buy ticket context, and submit answers for human review; it also provides public wallet earnings records. Users can create a bounty board and receive a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces Ed25519-signed certificates and provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, exposing 191 tools. It also includes five ready-to-use workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline checks token honeypot, tax, and liquidity risk, and provides market data including DEX slippage and funding rates. It offers REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This skill provides AI agents with instructions for joining KissCode (kisscode.ai), using SKILL.md and HEARTBEAT.md. It includes a registration API example and is licensed under MIT, making it a focused option for agents that need KissCode onboarding guidance.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings across geographic scales, from global coverage to street-level reporting. Reports include core conclusions and action suggestions, while semantic memory uses user interests to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an MCP endpoint for Western and Vedic astrology at astro-agent.dev/mcp, with no authentication required. It returns deterministic results with verifiable SHA-256 hashes and supports per-call REST payments via x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that uses three-layer loading to minimize token usage, with incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas. Its socket-based daemon architecture supports persistent connections, making it a distinct option for Hermes Agent skills that need to work with MCP servers.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This Nix project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, and automatically updates its packages daily. Its README provides `nix run` commands for the listed tools, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. It also documents OpenClaw setup and access to device hardware and UI through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models through Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct and CRD-based deployment workflows, plus configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, and scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image with mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module supports declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This project provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation options via an OCI registry or a published Helm repository. Provider-specific values examples and CI installation on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a deployment option with documented configuration examples and a Kubernetes install check.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local project graph with `codegraph init` and automatically syncs it when files change. Its MCP server connects that pre-indexed code knowledge to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, aiming to reduce token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token consumption across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Gemini. Its visualization dashboard helps analyze usage across supported clients such as OpenCode and Codex CLI.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for inspecting coding-agent API traffic, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It also lets you compare adjacent requests to see context changes and redacts common authentication headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools, reading Hermes Agent state alongside other CLI tools. Historical trends, usage breakdowns, and multi-device sync help track usage over time and across devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers. It works with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot, and is compatible with AI providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent, installable with `install.sh`. It includes product-development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop built around seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for customizing the Hermes terminal UI with banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. YAML-based configuration makes it easy to create themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk styles.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content in project directories, including configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. Its findings include suggested fixes and file locations, and it supports CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable @handles. It also facilitates commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin automatically captures and recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for CLI workflows that the project says can save 90–99% of tokens. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes agents with folder-local configuration, skills, memories, tools, and instructions. It can switch between the default agent and a scoped agent, making it suited to project-specific setups.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of Hermes Agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data and configuration to Hermes, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, memory archives, and credentials. It also sets up systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco is a Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations and monitors multi-agent systems. It offers passive analysis without token use or scheduled active probing, and uses local file changes to establish config-aware performance baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds wake-word voice interaction to Hermes Agent and runs offline without API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages through Piper and 9 through Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup is a local runtime for pursuing online earning opportunities, operating with zero network access by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: hermes-memoss is a memory plugin that provides semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It includes tools to search, add, and delete memories, plus a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC-Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with a built-in agent that does not require a separate CLI installation. It also includes 21 built-in professional assistants and supports macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides access to Hermes Agent from a web browser or phone through a three-panel interface for chat, sessions, and workspace. Its workspace includes a file browser, and the project is built with Python and vanilla JavaScript.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent that brings together chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It also supports visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, or Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace is a web workspace combining chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector panel. It also offers Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser and MCP catalog.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, as well as delegate across agents or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH and provides views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal allows direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first desktop app for Hermes Agent that also supports macOS, with native window and process management. It includes a Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, plus interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, Hermes Cloud, or self-hosted remote Hermes Agent runtime. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes Agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It is a client-only app for iOS 18 and later; users run the server themselves, and the app is free with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for token usage and latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs. Its tmux operator view also helps users manage live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser lets users search prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and supported image references across Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs. It can resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp, and tracks Codex and Claude quotas, tokens, and estimated API-equivalent cost.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted browser dashboard brings together a terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel. It also offers real-time chat with tool-call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace connects Hermes Agent to Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, with one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers. It also includes WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This self-hostable mission-control dashboard template pairs with a local Hermes agent through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox lets users review requests with side effects before they proceed.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also provides a kanban board for agentic work and task management, plus controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This locally run, mobile-first React SPA is a 10-page dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It includes terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, Telegram validation with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent offers a dark-themed GUI with multilingual support and session management. Its highlights include workflow automation, runtime tool creation, and support for local models through LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This self-hosted Hermes Agent interface pairs a glassmorphic chat experience with real-time log streaming. It also includes a file browser, task-tracking dashboard, and tools for managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a monitoring and configuration dashboard with real-time session activity and cost tracking. Users can inspect conversation histories and skill source code, while configuration and environment variables are available for read-only monitoring.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: PAN-UI is a self-hosted, chat-first AI workspace with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. Its marketplace supports discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, while isolated profiles keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client supports streaming chat and model switching alongside collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents. It also features a visual Skill Store with 50+ curated one-click installations and a PM orchestrator.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin for the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard shows configured model routes across profiles in one matrix. It previews changes before applying them, supports saved presets, and offers per-profile results with revision-guarded Undo.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: An unofficial, open-source interactive chat client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, Hermes UI Plus supports answer cards such as checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It also provides command approvals and live tool-step updates, and runs on Android, web, macOS, and Linux alpha.
